attributes.summary: Fixed mojibake found in the 2026-09-01 operator smoke: gmail.ts createDraft wrote Subject and recipient display names as raw UTF-8, which RFC 5322 forbids (Gmail reinterpreted the bytes as Latin-1, e.g. '— whaleybear → gmail' rendered as 'a€“ whaleybear a†' gmail'). Non-ASCII header values are now RFC 2047 encoded-words (=?UTF-8?B?...?=), applied to Subject and to display-name parts of To/Cc/Bcc; bare addresses and ASCII values pass through unchanged. Body untouched (already correct via charset=UTF-8). Orchestrator-authored surgical fix, test-first.

2 new vitest cases (non-ASCII subject decodes from base64url raw to an ASCII-clean encoded-word that round-trips to the original; non-ASCII display name encoded while plain addresses/subjects stay verbatim) written failing-first, then green; full suite 60/60 across 12 files, tsc build clean.

No scope changes.
